from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json
p=Path(__file__).parent
node='/Users/zhilu/.local/share/fnm/node-versions/v26.13.0/installation/bin/node'
for case in ['full','stress','full-reverse','stress-reverse','parse']:
 print('START '+case,flush=True)
 harness='parse-paired.mjs' if case=='parse' else 'scan-'+case+'.mjs'
 suffix='.mjs' if case=='parse' else '-export.mjs'
 with (p/(case+'.log')).open('w') as f:
  subprocess.run([node,str(p/harness),str(p/('masked'+suffix)),str(p/('plain'+suffix)),str(p/(case+'.json'))],stdout=f,stderr=f,check=True)
 data=json.loads((p/(case+'.json')).read_text());assert data['status']=='complete'
 print('DONE '+case,flush=True)
 for name,r in data['results'].items():
  s=r['summary'];print(name,round(s['changePercent'],2),[round(x,2) for x in s['ci95Percent']],flush=True)

import subprocess,pathlib,re,json
p=pathlib.Path(__file__).parent;node='/Users/zhilu/.local/share/fnm/node-versions/v26.13.0/installation/bin/node'
for name in ['baseline','reserved','segment']:
 f=p/(name+'-code26.log')
 with f.open('w') as out:
  subprocess.run([node,'--expose-gc','--trace-opt','--trace-deopt','--print-opt-code','--print-opt-code-filter=scan','--code-comments',str(p/'trace-stress.mjs'),'--worker',str(p/(name+'-export.mjs'))],stdout=out,stderr=out,check=True)
 s=f.read_text();codes=[]
 for i,block in enumerate(s.split('--- Raw source ---')[1:]):
  source=block.split('--- Optimized code ---')[0]
  if 'scratchLimit' not in source:continue
  body=block.split('--- End code ---')[0]
  out=p/(name+'-code26-'+str(i)+'.txt');out.write_text(body)
  codes.append({'file':out.name,'header':body.split('Instructions (size = ')[0][-800:],'instructionBytes':re.findall(r'Instructions \(size = (\d+)\)',body),'head':body.split('Instructions (size = ')[-1][:1000]})
 (p/(name+'-code26-index.json')).write_text(json.dumps(codes,indent=2))
 print(name,len(codes),'kernels',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json
p=Path(__file__).parent
node='/Users/zhilu/.local/share/fnm/node-versions/v26.13.0/installation/bin/node'
for case in ['full','stress','full-reverse','stress-reverse','parse-isolated','parse-total']:
 print('START '+case,flush=True)
 parsing=case.startswith('parse-')
 harness='parse-paired.mjs' if parsing else 'scan-'+case+'.mjs'
 suffix='.mjs' if parsing else '-export.mjs'
 a='baseline' if case=='parse-total' else 'inline'
 with (p/(case+'.log')).open('w') as f:
  subprocess.run([node,str(p/harness),str(p/(a+suffix)),str(p/('helper'+suffix)),str(p/(case+'.json'))],stdout=f,stderr=f,check=True)
 data=json.loads((p/(case+'.json')).read_text());assert data['status']=='complete'
 print('DONE '+case,flush=True)
 for name,r in data['results'].items():
  s=r['summary'];print(name,round(s['changePercent'],2),[round(x,2) for x in s['ci95Percent']],flush=True)
